trim_note: TRD Off-Road (from her Instagram post we commented on)
suspension: Dobinson 3 in lift, Dobinson struts and shocks
armor: Steel bumper with XRC Gen 3 winch
racks: Prinsu roof rack (Gobi ladder came with it)
story: I found Clifford on a Facebook Marketplace listing in 2025. It was already lifted with a Prinsu Roof Rack and Gobi ladder. I purchased it with cash and immediately drove it to Gulches Orv Park in Waterloo, SC to test it out. Since 2025, I've upgraded the lift suspension, inner and outer tie rods, sway bar end links, and external lighting with Baja Designs. I've driven it to and from Kentucky, North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, Florida, Tennessee, and Georgia. It has seen all kinds of terrain, including off-road parks, national parks trailing, and more.
